question: What power is responsible for bringing forth manifestation in this context?
premises: The power present there is called the power of will.
That very power brings forth its own task.
It brings it forth from within, in the form of its own desired object.
inference: Will-power alone is the inner creative agent that manifests its intended form.
plain_english: For the power present there, which is called the power of will, itself brings forth its own inner task in the form of what it desires.
